layers.title: 1 · Sources
layers.text: Kept exactly as received: the downloaded files and scans. Nothing in them is changed.

layers.title: 2 · Statements
layers.text: What each source says, with its words and place. Made by readers and rules; can be made again at any time.

layers.title: 3 · Decisions
layers.text: Reviews, misprints read, names fixed, your own choices – kept apart and applied on every rebuild.

layers.title: Presentation
layers.text: Pult draws from these: the reader, the Suda tab, the map, Tempora. Every item links back to its source.
